content:
Persona系列遊戲的音樂向來都是頂級水準，而《我的天啊》P3R**絕不**例外。透過這個音樂包，你可以盡情享受從遊戲原聲中精選的20首曲目。包含正確的藝人與歌曲資訊，支援美式英文的音樂提示通知。

**Persona 3 Reload：**

- Mass Destruction
- Master of Tartarus
- Master of Shadow
- Iwatodai Dorm
- During the Exams
- Deep Mentality
- Burn My Dread
- Battle Hymn of the Soul
- Memories of the City
- Color Your Night
- Paulownia Mall
- Tartarus Block 1
- Tartarus Block 6
- When The Moon's Reaching Out Stars
- Aria of the Soul

**Episode Aigis（新增）**：

- Abyss of Time: Block 2
- Darkness
- Mass Destruction (P3fes Reload)
- Don't
- Heartful Cry
